name: ChordGlass
tagline: Live guitar chords, key and tuning for what's playing on Spotify
description: Shows the chords of the song playing on Spotify in time with the music, plus its key, tuning and capo. Swipe to fine-tune sync, tap along to time a chart yourself.
author: ChordGlass

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Asks Spotify what song is playing and how far in it is, and downloads chord charts for that song.
